title: FA Workflow
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Create normalization CSV file
steps.instruction: Prepare a CSV file that normalizes samples by performing a 2‑fold dilution to the desired concentration and aliquoting each sample in triplicate. The file must include a header line "sample number,sample name,sample concentration (>0.25 mg/ml)" and list each sample as shown below:

substeps.instruction: Perform a 2‑fold dilution for each sample to reach the target concentration.
Aliquot each diluted sample into three equal portions.

Download the template CSV from the provided link if needed.

steps.title: Input protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the desired protocol parameters into the designated fields of the workflow interface.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it on your computer if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the custom labware JSON files to upload.

steps.title: Upload Python protocol file
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, open the Protocol tab and upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the labware on the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tiprack, and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the Opentrons App to calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette; consult the support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the ‘Run’ button in the Opentrons App to start the protocol execution.
